description: He wears a dark forest-green knee-length tunic with gold-toned knotwork bands at the center front, sleeve cuffs and hem, over a cream underlayer visible at neck and wrists. A thick matching green cloak with knotwork edging drapes over one shoulder and across the chest, secured by a round decorated metal brooch. A broad dark leather belt bears several round ornamental fittings and a long hanging tail. Brown trousers and tall brown leather boots with diagonal wrapping straps complete the ensemble. A small metal ring is visible on one hand. Fabrics appear thick and wool-like, but exact fibers are uncertain. The torso and limbs are fully clothed, with no headgear, weapons or armor.
